authoringStatement: Expected codes, paths, values, counters, and stage decisions were manually authored before the F2 production decoder and are not regenerated from it.

classificationPolicy.external-definition: A language or encoding definition maintained outside this project.
classificationPolicy.inherited-reviewed-project-decision: A literal or law independently frozen and proven by the preceding F1 package.
classificationPolicy.reviewed-project-decision: A product/schema/security boundary selected and checked into this repository.
classificationPolicy.stage-ownership-decision: A deliberate package boundary that keeps structural and semantic authority separate.

no getters/prototypes/iterators/repair, Proxy caveat, byte-bound external path, depth/cycle scan, and allocation counters
